physical_model: incompressible laminar flow with Boussinesq forcing, frozen material properties, P1 solid-fluid temperature, P2 velocity and P1 kinematic pressure
selection_policy: Select the first operating point satisfying flow-regime, equation, conservation and resolution checks. Optimizer speed is excluded from operating-point selection. Retain all attempts.
control: Unbounded signed distributed source with quadratic penalty; temperature has finite lower and upper bounds.
unknown: Complete temperature trajectory; momentum is solved at each nonlinear evaluation and the source is recovered from all coupled thermal equations.
gauss_newton: W + alpha J_U^T W J_U + damping W; exact reduced objective gradient for final KKT tests.
rank_selection: Use setup-inclusive verified pilot cost, then freeze before final repeated comparisons.
methods: scaled recycling retaining existing coarse vectors and new directions
reference: Computed-baseline spatial modes and mode-dependent temporal compression. The reference stays fixed across optimization queries and active-set steps.

accuracy.gradient_Taylor_test: Second-order remainder over at least three successive halvings before roundoff.

resolution_policy: Reevaluate the same saved source history on a finer forward grid without clipping. Refine space and time separately. Freeze the coarsest passing discretization before final timings.
timing_boundary: Reference construction, assembly, every nonlinear and active-set solve, tangent and adjoint solves, transfers, verification and cleanup. Report process initialization and common calibration separately.
claims: Discrete stationary solutions and matched computational comparisons. Physical resolution and acceleration require their own verification; no global nonlinear optimality claim.
